products.name: ALFIX 46 FIX/J/30

products.description: Alfix 46 FIX/J/30 is part of the Alfix 46 range, namely the professional system designed by Profilpas to lay LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors of thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm. Specifically, FIX/J/30 is a profile to join level floors. Like all other solutions in the range, FIX/J/30 comprises a top profile in anodised aluminium secured with screws in the same colour as the anodised aluminium, on a natural aluminium base.

products.name: ALFIX 46 FIX/L/32
products.category: Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Alfix 46 FIX/L/32 is a profile to join LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors of different heights. This element, which is part of the wider Alfix 46 range, is one of the solutions available for laying this kind of floor, for thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm. Alfix 46 FIX/L/32 comprises a top profile, available in silver anodised aluminium, secured with screws in the same colour as the anodized aluminium, on a natural aluminium base.

products.name: ALFIX 46 FIX/T/19
products.category: Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Alfix 46 FIX/T/19 edging profile is part of the Alfix 46 range, the professional system designed by Profilpas for the laying of LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors of thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm. Like the other two elements in the range – FIX/J/30 and FIX/L/32 - FIX/T/19 also comprises a top profile in anodised aluminium which is secured with screws to a natural aluminium base. The screws are the same colour as the anodised aluminium and integrate seamlessly with the top profile.

products.name: ALFIX 616 FIX/J/44
products.category: Profiles for wooden and laminate floors
products.description: Profiles for wood and laminate floors - by Profilpas The Alfix 616 aluminium range also includes item FIX/J/44, the perfect profile for joints between wood and laminate floors at the same level. It is used with floating floors of thicknesses between 6 and 16mm, to separate, protect and decorate the floor, accommodating any expansion. It comprises two parts: an anodised aluminium top profile measuring 44mm, and a natural aluminium base. The two parts are attached via a screw system of the same colour as the profile, supplied in the package, to ensure they blend and create a uniform final effect.

products.name: ALFIX 616 FIX/L/55
products.category: Profiles for wooden and laminate floors
products.description: One of Profilpas’ products for floating wooden and laminate floors at different heights is the Alfix 616 FIX/L/55 system. This item creates an aluminium joint, ideal for floors widths of 6 to 16mm. FIX/L/55 is 55mm wide and comprises an anodised aluminium top profile and a natural aluminium base. Both are secured with screws which are provided, in the same colour as the top profile.

products.name: ALFIX 616 FIX/T/33
products.category: Profiles for wooden and laminate floors
products.description: The Alfix 616 range of professional aluminium systems for wood and laminate floors also includes the FIX/T/33 edge piece. This outside edge allows you to end the floor with a 90-degree angle. It was designed for 6-16mm thick floors and comprises an anodised aluminium top profile that is 33m wide and a natural aluminium base. It is secured with a screw system: the screws are provided and are the same colour as the anodised aluminium, to blend in perfectly with the top profile.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE Q
products.description: External corners profiles Cerfix Proangle Q is the range of square-shaped profiles for edging and protecting the external corners of ceramic coverings, avoiding the delicate and unsightly 45° edge between tiles. Available in aluminium, steel, brass and PVC, this range offers a wide choice of finishes to meet any requirement. In addition, the innovative Trend Color finishes are ideal for those who love elegance and are looking for the perfect match for the trendiest ceramics.

products.name: CERFIX PROBORD IL/ - ILE/ - ILES/
products.description: External corner profiles - by Profilpas Probord IL/, ILE/ and ILES/ are external corner profiles which stand out for their soft lines and shapes. These products, which are ideal for accident prevention in environments such as hospitals, swimming pools, wellness centres and industrial kitchens, are characterised by rounded corners. In addition, Probord IL features a single-flange fastening system that facilitates the correct alignment of the profile even in the presence of uneven angles and surfaces.

products.name: CERFIX PROBORD ILN
products.description: External corners profiles - by Profilpas Probord ILN is a range of profiles intended to protect external corners and edges in tiled wall coverings. Available in AISI 304 and 316 stainless steel, these profiles are ideal in settings requiring high standards of hygiene and also act as a safety feature. This combination of features makes Probord INL profiles especially good for settings like kitchens, food manufacturers, schools, and any location where hygiene is essential. The AISI 316 stainless steel version withstands chlorine and salt water/air and is therefore suitable for spas, swimming pools, and coastal locations.

products.name: CERFIX PROCORNER M
products.description: External corners profiles - by Profilpas Procorner M is a line of profiles to protect the external corners of wall coverings, to be applied on already installed wall coverings. Available in aluminium, stainless steel and brass, Procorner M profiles are available with a square or rounded corner section and are also available in a self-adhesive version for quick and easy DIY installation.

products.name: CERFIX PROCORNER P
products.description: External corners profiles - by ProfilpasProcorner P is a corner protection profile for accident prevention. Recommended in environments such as schools, offices, kindergartens, public spaces, it is made of soft PVC and in bright colours to visually highlight the edges of the wall covering.

products.name: CERFIX PROCOVER
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Procover are expansion joint covers that create continuity over commercial or generally large-size floors. Available in different materials and formats, they are perfect for covering structural expansion and contraction movements in two different load-bearing structures and hiding any cutting and/or laying imperfections. These items easily withstand foot and motor vehicle traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROCOVER FIX
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Procover Fix is part of the Profilpas range of joint cover profiles. These items, made of aluminium, are characterised by a flat shape and are available in two versions: one for joining two coplanar surfaces (GJA/) and one for joining floor and wall covering (GWA/). Procover Fix structural joint covers are the best choice for covering structural expansion or compression movements of two different load-bearing structures and, at the same time, concealing any cutting and/or laying imperfections.

products.name: CERFIX PROCOVER FLEX
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Procover Flex is an expansion joint cover for floor sections at the same level. This article, featuring a load-bearing structure in natural aluminium and a black EPDM insert, effectively responds to horizontal traction and contraction movements in industrial or generally large buildings. It is especially suited to surfaces required to withstand foot and motor vehicle traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PRODECOR
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Prodecor is a range of profiles designed to finish, seal and protect level tiled, marble, granite, wooden and other types of floor. Thanks to its versatility, Prodecor is also perfect as a separation joint, for example, between tiled floors and carpet or wood, as a perimeter profile to contain doormats, and to protect ceramic tiled steps and platforms. The part on view of the profile lends an elegance to the floor but is not invasive, blending seamlessly into the surface.

products.name: CERFIX PRODECOR DJ
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Prodecor DJ profiles protect and seal level tiled, marble, granite, wooden or other types of floor, and uncouple floors of different materials. The part on view of the profile blends seamlessly into the floor, creating an elegant surface decoration. Prodecor DJ is also suitable as a perimeter profile to contain doormats, platforms and to protect ceramic tiled steps.

products.name: CERFIX PRODECOR DJ FLEX
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Bendable profiles - by Profilpas PROFLEX LINE is a line of bendable profiles for installing ceramic tile, wooden, carpet, laminate floors, and other materials where there is the need to outline curvilinear surfaces. These profiles are easily adaptable to the required curvatures thanks to the use of Proflex Machine. ZGF, AIF, ZNF, and ZBGF profiles can be bent without using a Proflex Machine, after mechanical fixing to the ground through pressure screws.

products.name: CERFIX PROINT
products.category: Internal corner profiles; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Internal corners profiles - by Profilpas Proint is a line of internal corner profiles available in aluminium, steel and PVC designed for the perimeter connection in the installation between wall and floor or as a perimeter joint. The particular sections of this line in fact facilitate corner expansion between the two surfaces. Installation is very simple and avoids the use of silicone for sealing, an advantage both from an aesthetic and a hygienic point of view: the absence of silicone in fact prevents the proliferation of dirt and bacteria.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NAN
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint DIL NAN is a natural aluminium expansion joint with an interchangeable elastic vinyl resin insert, available in either grey or stone grey. The special structure of the Projoint DIL NAN joint allows it to protect the edge of the tile and at the same time withstand a high volume of traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular. The strength and shock-absorbing capacity make this expansion joint perfect for use in working and industrial environments. The perforated flanges ensure perfect anchoring between the previously split screed, the profile and the tiles.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NE
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Among the wide and varied range of Profilpas expansion joints is Projoint DIL NE, a coextruded PVC profile available in different colours and heights. Projoint DIL NE, to be installed with adhesive at fractionation joints created in the screed, is suitable for use on large surfaces with high foot traffic and allows for easy and effective absorption of compression and expansion stresses.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NF
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Large surfaces subject to heavy foot traffic often require expansion joints that can absorb physical stresses. Precisely for this reason, Profilpas has created Projoint DIL NF. The product, made of co-extruded PVC, is available in different colours and heights and is perfect for splitting ceramic flooring. This element, ideal for mortar laying, is a guarantee of quality and responds effectively to compression and expansion stresses.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NIL
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint DIL NIL is a perimeter expansion joint in stainless steel, with an interchangeable insert in elastic vinyl resin, characterized by a visible section of 14 mm. The structure of the joint allows to connect the floor to the wall and is able to withstand heavy traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular (forklifts, transpallets and cars).

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NIN
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint DIL NIN is a stainless steel expansion joint with an interchangeable elastic vinyl resin insert. The special structure of the joint provides optimal protection of the tile edge and thus withstands all types of traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular (forklifts, pallet trucks and cars), making it particularly suitable for industrial and commercial environments. The perforated flanges ensure perfect anchoring between the previously split screed, the profile and the tiles.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NJ
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint DIL NJ is a co-extruded PVC expansion joint with perforated side flanges for perfect anchorage between the (previously split) screed, the profile and the tiles. This profile adapts perfectly to adhesive-laid floors and, thanks to the elasticity of the central part, is able to absorb compression and expansion stress with ease. The PVC used is non-toxic and shockproof, is UV-resistant and can be used indoors and outdoors.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NL
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint DIL NL is a co-extruded PVC expansion joint. The product - made of non-toxic, shockproof and UV-resistant material - features perforated side flanges for perfect anchorage between the (previously split) screed, profile and tiles. NL is ideal for adhesive-laid floors or marble between 8 and 20 millimetres thick and, thanks to its elastic central part, is able to absorb compression and expansion stresses. This characteristic makes the profile particularly suitable for surfaces with light pedestrian or vehicle traffic (cars and pallet trucks) indoors or outdoors.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NPAN
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint NPAN is a natural aluminium floor expansion joint with an interchangeable insert in elastic vinyl resin, 21mm wide. The structure of Projoint NPAN joints means they protect the corner of the tile while withstanding the contraction and expansion caused by high traffic loads, both pedestrian and vehicle. perforated flanges ensure perfect grip between the concrete substrate (previously laid in sections), the profile, and the tiles.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NTA
products.category: Joints for floors; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NTI

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NTO
products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas Projoint DIL NTO is an expansion joint for adhesive-laying with a natural brass structure and vulcanised EPDM inner section, which effectively withstands frequent pedestrian and vehicular traffic (forklift trucks, pallet trucks and cars). products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NZA
products.category: Joints for floors; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NZS

The design of the joint protects the edge of the tile and at the same time provides high resistance to pedestrian and vehicle traffic.

A very useful feature especially for workplaces and industrial settings. In particular, Projoint DIL NZS/A/40 model is the joint-covering version, with the same features, but intended for installation on already-existing flooring.

Projoint DIL NZS/L/ is suitable for use in areas and surfaces subject to intense pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

products.description: Movement joints - by Profilpas The resistance and the quality of the steel, strengthened by an inner core in vulcanised EPDM, make the Projoint Dil STI/ floor expansion joint ideal for laying sections of mortar floors. The product has a metal structure able to easily withstand pedestrian and vehicle traffic (fork-lift trucks, pallet trucks and motor vehicles, etc.). These properties make Projoint Dil STI/ the ideal solution to finish and strengthen areas subject to frequent passing loads.

products.name: CERFIX PROLIST
products.category: Listello tile trims and decorative profiles
products.description: Listellos and decorative profiles - by Profilpas Cerfix Prolist is a range of decorative listello tile trims designed and produced for wall coverings. The listello tile trims come in two different materials - steel and aluminium - which in turn have a wide choice of finishes. It is a line designed to create refined and attractive decorative effects on ceramic wall coverings and, thanks to their wide versatility, they prove to be perfect elements in any context. In fact, The Cerfix Prolist line of decorative listello tile trims can be successfully used in residential and public settings.

products.name: CERFIX PROLIST X DESIGN
products.category: Listello tile trims and decorative profiles
products.description: For interior decorators and architects, Profilpas has designed a range of listello tile trims in anodised aluminium that reflect the latest trends in home interiors and design. The various finishes have a special brushed effect and are perfect to create pleasing visual effects on ceramic tile coverings. X Design also includes Proangle Q external corner profiles to give an impeccable and all-round finish to the covering.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL L
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights
products.description: Pronivel L is a profile used to join floors of different thicknesses (10mm) and of the same or different materials. It can be laid on existing floors using a simple and effective adhesive. There are also two versions of the profile, in aluminium or brass, to provide the best possible solution to a wide range of applications.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL M
products.category: External corner profiles; Profiles for floors of different heights
products.description: Profiles for floors of different height - by Profilpas Pronivel M is a range of profiles designed to couple floors at different levels and prevent the unsightly and dangerous steps that would otherwise be created. Available in aluminium, stainless steel, and brass, these profiles are ideal for joining carpeted or LVT floors. Thanks to the special shape, the Pronivel M MIN/ stainless steel profile can be used to finish and protect 135-degree external corners in tiled coverings.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL N
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights
products.description: Profiles for floors of different height - by Profilpas Pronivel N is a profile to join floors at different heights (from 10 to 20mm), offering extreme flexibility. It has a load-bearing structure and two lips of different sizes, which work together to reduce the step between two floors of different thicknesses. The many different combinations and articulated joints allow the perfect solution to be found for every requirement and mean a new floor can also be overlaid, even after the profile has been inserted.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL P
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights
products.description: Pronivel P is a profile used to join floors of different thicknesses, to be inserted while the floor is being laid. It comes as aluminium, stainless steel and brass. The sloping section reduces the step, from 4.5mm to 20mm, caused by the different thickness in the two parts of the floor.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL PB
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Profiles for floors of different height

products.name: CERFIX PROROUND B
products.description: Internal corner profiles - by Profilpas Proround B is a perimeter joint profile available in aluminium, stainless steel and PVC, suitable for wall coverings where a high level of hygiene must be maintained. This internal corner profile can be applied directly onto the already laid surface using special adhesives. It is the perfect solution during a renovation or for retrofitting already finished spaces. Proround B in stainless steel is particularly resistant to organic and inorganic attack and is especially suitable for hospitals, restaurants, canteens, food and chemical industries.

products.name: CERFIX PROROUND M
products.category: Internal corner profiles; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Internal corners profiles - by Profilpas Proround M is an aluminium or stainless steel profile which acts as a connection between floor and wall covering. The cove-shaped design removes the 90° inside corner to prevent the build-up of dirt, a source of bacteria, creating a curved surface that makes daily cleaning easier and more efficient. The stainless steel version is recommended in spaces where a particular level of hygiene is required, such as hospitals, industrial kitchens, food industries and so on. In particular, AISI 316 DIN 1.4404 stainless steel is recommended for environments with higher chemical stress and in sea areas.

products.name: CERFIX PROROUND P
products.description: Internal corners profiles - by Profilpas Proround P is a non-toxic, shock-proof PVC internal corner profile. This cove-shaped profile acts as a connection between floor and wall covering, preventing dirt from building up and facilitating corner cleaning. This profile is available with two anchor flanges for fixing to the wall, or with only one. The latter is suitable as a connector between floors and wall coverings of different thicknesses.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SA-SB
products.description: Prostep SA and SB profiles are ideal to lay and protect coverings on ceramic, cotto and stone coverings on steps. Available in different heights, to meet all requirements, these profiles have an aluminium base and a ridged PVC insert compliant with regulation DIN 51131 governing non-slip steps that can be replaced in the event of wear.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SAR-SIR
products.description: Prostep SAR and SIR are aluminium (SAR) and stainless steel (SIR) stair nosings, designed to protect the edges of steps and stairs. In addition, they can also be used as trims to protect the edges of external pavements. The reversible shapes means Prostep SAR and SIR can be used with ceramic tiles of four different thicknesses.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SGI SGA SGN SGK
products.description: Prostep SGA, SGI, SGN and SGK were designed for use when laying ceramic tile, marble and stone steps, and to protect them. Thanks to the rounded profile, they add elegance and sophistication to step edges. So, as well as protection, they also add visual appeal. These models come in aluminium, brass and stainless steel. The latter is recommended for situations with high foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SIS
products.description: Prostep SIS is a stainless steel profile designed to build and protect, during the laying process, ceramic, marble and stone steps. It guarantees excellent resistance to the main chemical and atmospheric agents and, thanks to the ridged tread, is compliant with DIN 51131 standards regarding non-slip steps. Prostep SIS is also especially recommended to protect steps subject to intense foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SIX
products.description: Prostep SIX is a stainless steel profile designed to build and protect, during the laying process, ceramic, marble and stone steps. The application of Safety-Step non-slip strips on stair treads assures Prostep Six profiles are compliant with DIN 51131 standards regarding non-slip steps, and is suitable for protecting steps in areas subjects to intense foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SM SMA
products.description: Prostep SMA and SM are aluminium and natural brass profiles, designed to create and protect ceramic tile, marble or stone steps. Prostep SMA and SM are laid at the same time as the covering, to assure they are set seamlessly into it. Moreover, thanks to the knurled surface, they are also non-slip, certified to DIN 51131. These characteristics make Prostep SMA and SM suitable for a variety of settings, from private to public contexts subject to intense foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SNG-SN
products.description: Prostep SNG and SN are aluminium (SNG) and brass (SN) profiles designed to build and protect, during the laying process, ceramic, marble and stone steps. Prostep SNG comes in the following heights: 8, 10, 12,5 and 15 millimetres, while Prostep SN is made in 8, 10 and 12.5 millimetres.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SP
products.description: Prostep SP is a profile to build and protect, during the laying process, of ceramic, cotto and stone coverings on steps. Available in different heights (8, 10 or 12.5mm) and made from an aluminium base and a ridged PVC insert, Prostep SP guarantees a high degree of safety: in fact, it complies with DIN 51131 standards regarding non-slip steps. The different colours of PVC means the product can be made to fit a variety of requirements.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTYLE
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Prostyle is a range of profiles suitable for use as both a finish or decorative element on level ceramic tile, granite, marble and other kinds of floor. These profiles are also found as separation joints and a decorative feature between floors of different materials. Specifically, the stainless steel version acts as a protection for ceramic tiled steps and solves the problem of passing high loads that are typical in commercial and industrial settings.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPBV
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by ProfilpasProtec CPBV is a series of edge profiles for the protection and the finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium, they have been designed with a protruding section. In addition to protecting and finishing the outside edges, they guarantee the outflow of water from the floor, avoiding the contact with the outside border. They can be installed with tiles or marble of any thickness.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPCV-CPCI
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by Profilpas Protec CPCV and CPCI are a series of edging profiles to protect and finish the outer edges of terraces and balconies. The cross-section with overhang assures water is carried away from the tiled surface, avoiding any contact with the outer edges. Available in painted aluminium (CPCV) and stainless steel (CPCI), they can be used for tiles up to 21mm thick.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPCV/30/
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by Profilpas Protec CPCV/30/ is an edging profile to protect and finish the outer edges of terraces and balconies. It is the solution for old terraces: the reduced dimensions of the protruding section allow to avoid removing the perimetral balustrades in case of refurbishment. This profile is available in colour-coated aluminium, for tile thicknesses up to 12.5 mm thick.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPCVD
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces Cerfix Protec CPCVD/30 is a draining perimeter profile, provided with a visible part that facilitates the outflow of rainwater from the tiled surface and an underlying protruding part equipped with holes for a further discharge of the water seeped under the tiles. The reduced dimensions of the visible part allow to avoid removing the perimetral balustrades in case of refurbishment.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPEV-CPEI
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by ProfilpasProtec CPEV and CPEI are a series of edge reversible profiles for the protection and finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium (CPEV) and stainless steel (CPEI), they can be installed flush with the border or detached from it. They can be used with tiles or marble thicknesses from 11 to 32 mm. The particular section is recommended to protect the stair nosing and sidewalk edge, hiding the connection between tread and riser.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPGV
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces Cerfix Protec CPGV is a range of perimeter profiles made of painted aluminum for the protection and finishing of the external edges of terraces and balconies. The profile consists of a visible vertical section that facilitates the drainage of rainwater from the tiled surface and protects the edge of the flooring, and of a cantilevered section equipped with slotted holes that allow additional discharge of water filtered beneath the tiles. The maximum tile thickness suitable for installing Protec CPGV is 12.5 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPHA
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by Profilpas Protec CPHA - CPHV is an edge profile in anodised (CPHA) and colour-coated (CPHV) aluminium for terraces, balconies and pavements. The shape allows the outflow of water, avoiding the direct contact with the screed. Installed along the perimeter, it allows to outline ceramic tiles and to protect the border in many fields of use. It can be used with tiles thicknesses up to 21 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPLV
products.line: Profiles for floors and coverings; Raised floors
products.category: Profiles for balconies and terraces; Laying accessories
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by ProfilpasProtec CPLV is a line of perimetral profiles in colour-coated aluminium, for the protection and finishing of the borders of outdoor raised floors, terraces or balconies. They are composed of a drilled base CPLB to be screwed to the supports, or, as an alternative, a cut base CPLB/2 for glued tiles, and a visible profile CPLV to be fixed with adhesive, available in 3 different heights according to the floor thickness. There are also special accessories for the creation of external corners and junctions.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPNV
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces - by ProfilpasProtec CPNV is a series of edge profiles for the protection and the finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium, they can be installed flush with the border or detached from it. Their special section makes them suitable for the protection of the borders of steps or sidewalks, since it hides the junction between the tread and the riser. Protec CPNV is also available in the bendable version CPNVF, provided with a special cutout that allows to bend the profile with a radius up to 40 cm.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPQV
products.description: Profiles for balconies and terraces Cerfix Protec CPQV is a range of perimeter profiles for the protection and finishing of the external edges of terraces and balconies. The profile features a visible vertical section that covers the edge of the flooring and allows the runoff of rainwater flowing over the tiled surface; additional slotted holes on the cantilevered section enable further drainage of water filtered beneath the tiles. This technical solution and the resulting drainage reduce problems related to freeze–thaw cycles and unsightly efflorescence that typically appears on cementitious grout joints. Suitable for tiles up to 12.5 mm thick.

products.name: CERFIX PROTOP
products.description: Profiles in the Protop range are used to finish and protect external corners and edges in tiled kitchens and worktops. Made of anodised aluminium, they are also perfect for tiled platforms and steps. Protop offer protection and are also part of the finishing details which undoubtedly make the difference in the kitchen.

products.name: CERFIX PROTRIM
products.category: External corner profiles; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: External corners profiles - by Profilpas Protrim is a profile designed to seal and protect the external corners and edges of tiled floors, steps and platforms, it is available in aluminium, stainless steel, brass and PVC. The characteristic rounded shape makes Protrim profiles ideal as a symmetrical finish, but also as a safety feature around the corner and edge of the wall covering. Thanks to the large variety of finishes and materials, these items adapt perfectly to every style of interior. Of the many versions produced, there is also one in anti-bacterial painted aluminium, in compliance with ISO 22196:2011 standards. This special technology reduces the presence of bacteria by 99%.

products.name: CERFIX PROTRIM IP
products.category: External corner profiles; Stair nosing profiles
products.description: External corners profiles - by Profilpas Protrim IP are minimalist profiles in aluminium or stainless steel, suitable for the edging of external corners that need the 45 degrees cut. These profiles allow a perfect installation both on wall coverings and on stairs or platforms in ceramic or wood.

products.name: CERFIX PROTRIM N
products.description: External corners profiles - by Profilpas Protrim N is a line of stainless steel external corner profiles with a slightly rounded shape. The special steel alloys used make Protrim N profiles perfect for use in a variety of settings: AISI 304 stainless steel is ideal for food production sites, kitchens and hospitals, while AISI 316 stainless steel - thanks to its resistance to the main chemical and atmospheric agents, chlorine and salt water - is recommended for swimming pools, spas and seaside areas.

DECOR SYSTEM 70 finishes also have an irregular , matt effect with an attractive finish. Areas of use: Shops, department stores, offices, restaurants, hotel receptions, private homes, coffee bars, hotels, showrooms, etc.

products.name: DIY PROFILES
products.description: Range of DIY profiles With its full range, Profilpas has provided an effective answer to the requirements of those needing to do home improvement work in domestic and industrial settings without the help of a professional. In particular, Profilpas offers a huge range of DIY profiles in a variety of materials, from aluminium to stainless steel and brass. Available in several commercial sizes, these products make light and easy work of the jobs, guaranteeing Profilpas quality at every stage. The following profiles appear in more detail in the Profilpas catalogue: Flat Corner L-shaped U-shaped drainage channel Double U-shaped drainage channel Bull nose Round tube Square tube Rectangular tube T-profile Round profile Square profile In addition to these, the range also includes profiles for silver anodised aluminium structures and counterweights for rounded shower curtain rails.

The kit is used to create floor drains in terraces and balconies, bathrooms, boiler rooms, laundries and wet environments. Drain Vertical is available in 5 diameters: 50 - 75 - 82 - 90 - 100 mm, while Drain Lateral is available in 3 diameters: 50 - 75 - 90 mm.

products.name: DURSILITE
products.description: Highly washable and extra hiding interior wall paint, available in many colours DURSILITE is a highly washable , professional water-based wall paint for interiors , made with modified acrylic resins in water dispersion and selected fillers. It gives the surface a nice smooth , silky, matt finish , with low dirt pick-up and excellent whiteness level . DURSILITE stands out for its maximum hiding classification and its excellent washability . These features, together with the ease of application , make it ideal for protection and decoration of all environments, particularly where chromatic projects of any colour and intensity are envisaged. DURSILITE can be produced in a wide range of customized colours .

products.name: DURSILITE BASE COAT
products.description: Smooth uniforming pigmented and colourable undercoat. Ideal for non-homogenous substrates DURSILTE BASE COAT is a smooth wall undercoat for professional use, based on modified acrylic resins in aqueous dispersion and selected fillers. It evens out the absorption of the substrate and promotes the adhesion of water-based paints and wall enamels, it has a high hiding power and capacity to even out surfaces . DURSILITE BASE COAT is used to hide previous dark-coloured paints or even out chromatic unevenness: it is particularly indicated in case of bright colours with limited hiding power. Easy to apply it is essential in case of uneven substrates .

products.name: DURSILITE GYPSOS
products.description: Mould resistant, extra washable and hiding water-based interior paint. Ideal for plasterboards and modern construction systems. DURSILITE GYPSOS is an interior wall paint for professional use, based on modified acrylic resins in aqueous dispersion and selected fillers. It gives the surface a smooth , silky and highly matt finish with an excellent whiteness level . Its highest hiding and opacity classification, extreme washability , mould resistance and the ease of application , make DURSILITE GYPSOS ideal for plasterboards or modern building systems where it is necessary to hide the joints between the boards.

products.name: DURSILITE IGEA
products.description: Mould resistant, breathable water-based interior paint. Ideal for kitchens and bathrooms and rooms subject to condensation DURSILITE IGEA is an interior wall paint for professional use, based on modified acrylic resins in aqueous dispersion and selected fillers. It gives the surface a pleasant , uniform and highly matt finish with an excellent whiteness level . Its high breathability and its resistance to moulds , make DURSILITE IGEA suitable for all environments with persistent humidity or condensation . Ideal for bathrooms and kitchens.

Ideal for filling small features or skimming entire walls , solve all filling and levelling requirements on substrates prior to a painting cycle. The product has excellent workability and is easy to sand down without shrinking, flaking or cracking.

products.name: DURSILITE MASTER
products.description: Breathable water-based interior paint with good opacity. Ideal for large surfaces. Interior wall paint for professional use, based on modified acrylic resins in aqueous dispersion and selected fillers. DURSILITE MASTER gives the surface a pleasant smooth , silky , matt finish with high whiteness level. Its excellent hiding , its high breathability and its ease of application, make it suitable for quick paint of all interior walls and ceilings and ideal for large surface areas .

products.name: DURSILITE MATT
products.description: Washable water-based interior paint with good opacity. Ideal for extra matt finishings DURSILITE MATT is an interior wall paint for professional use, based on modified acrylic resins in aqueous dispersion and selected fillers. It gives the surface a pleasant smooth , silky , highly matt and even finish. It stands out for its washability and hiding power . These characteristics, together with the ease of application, make DURSILITE MATT ideal for protection and decoration of all residential spaces, particularly when a highly matt finishing is requested.

products.name: MAPEPROOF FBH
products.description: Waterproof membrane in HDPE sandwiched to non-woven fabric backing for fully-bonded waterproofing of underground structures MAPEPROOF FBH is a waterproof membrane fully-bonded to placed concrete. It consists of a synthetic membrane in HDPE sandwiched to non-woven fabric in polypropylene which, once concrete has been placed, forms a monolithic bond with the concrete and remains perfectly bonded over time. This type of bond prevents water migrating laterally between the foundations and the membrane. MAPEPROOF FBH also forms a highly effective barrier against groundwater, moisture in the ground, radon and methane. MAPEPROOF FBH system is completed with a series of accessory application products such as MAPEPROOF FBT TAPE 600 and MAPEPROOF LIQUID MEMBRANE . To provide continuity to waterproofing applied on vertical walls, it is possible to apply MAPEPROOF AL 1200 AP self-adhesive membrane in HDPE or MAPEPROOF SA waterproofing membrane made from a robust film of cross-weave high-density polyethylene (HDPE), or a MAPETHENE HT or MAPETHENE LT self-adhesive membrane. Using this system enables an effective, fully–bonded waterproofing membrane to be created both before and after placing concrete for foundations. MAPEPROOF FBH system is highly versatile. It may be used to waterproof any type of foundation and by any specialised waterproofing contractor with experience of other types waterproofing systems for foundations.

products.description: Soundproofing panels for floating screeds compliant with legal requirements. MAPESILENT PANEL is a soundproofing system made up of panels specifically developed to effectively guarantee the best soundproofing properties for floors to counteract impact and footstep noise ; complies with passive acoustic requirements specified by Prime-ministerial Decree 5-12-97 and meets requirements for the highest acoustic efficiency classes specified by UNI 11367. MAPESILENT PANEL is characterised by its ability to increase the thermal insulation and soundproofing capacity of floors, as well as its high resistance to tears and impact loads, properties which help prevent potential damage during site activities. As a support to design engineers, MAPEI offers their free DataMapesilent ® acoustic calculation software to help design and verify the acoustic and thermal performance properties of floors soundproofed with MAPESILENT PANEL. MAPESILENT PANEL is used in combination Mapesilent Tape to prevent acoustic bridge phenomenon. Ideal for: Meeting the passive acoustic requirements of PM Decree 5-12-97 and to improve the acoustic class of buildings , increasing the insulating and soundproofing capacity of floors, preventing damage to the soundproofing system during routine site activities, creating perfectly isolated floating screeds on which to install any type of flooring, being part of the design process to calculate expected acoustic performance properties It is recommended to contact our Technical Services Division for further information about Mapei soundproofing solutions and integrated systems.

Part B into Part A and mix with a drill fitted with a whip until the resin is completely smooth. Mixing ratio: 1 part by weight Part A and 1 part by weight Part B. It is used for creating anchorage points for repairs, reinforcement and static upgrading of structures in reinforced cement, masonry and tuff using MapeWrap C fabrics and Carboplate. MapeWrap C FIOCCO is set in place after it has been impregnated with MapeWrap 21 two component, super-fluid, solvent-free epoxy resin, a product specially developed for impregnating MapeWrap fabrics on site. After pulling out the cord through the hole on the top of the package, cut off at the length required with a pair of scissors. When the resin has set, remove the mesh from the part of the cord which is not impregnated with resin so that it is easier to open out the carbon fibres. products.description: Two-component waterproofing and consolidating primer, in solvent solution, for screeds and industrial flooring. Where to use: - Primer for the consolidation of surfaces of dusty or crumbly cementitious screeds, for anhydrite screeds, radiant heated screeds, old terrazzo tiles, gypsum and gypsum board. - Waterproofing damp screeds to isolate residual moisture. - Anti-dust impregnating primer over industrial flooring, garages, raised flooring. If a levelling compound is used after the application of Primer EP, spread dry sand over the just treated surface to create a suitable mechanical key. The substrate must be dry and clean, free of oil, grease, traces of paint and any loose particles. Technical data: Minimum drying time: 24 hours depending on the porosity of the substrate. Consistency: liquid. Colour: transparent. Flammability: yes. Application temperature range: from 10°C to 40°C. Pot life of the mixture: 4-5 hours. Mixing ratio: Part A : Part B = 1 : 1. Storage: 24 months. Application: by roller, brush or watering can. Consumption 0.5-0.7 kg/m2. Packaging 5 5 kg drums.

products.name: PROCLASSIC F
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Proclassic F is a range of threshold profiles with a flat cross-section, designed to hide the joint between two sections of floor of different materials. Without the convex shape, it can be used under doors and the non-slip knurled surface helps to increase safety. Proclassic F is available in aluminium and brass, in widths from 15mm to 40mm.

products.name: PROCLASSIC FIRE LEVEL
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Profiles for floors of equal height Proclassic Fire Level is a range of stainless steel AISI 316 profiles designed to be installed at the base of fire-rated doors or any door that requires a non-combustible transition element. With a thickness of 2.5 mm, it is intended to be positioned during the flooring installation to ensure a seamless, level connection with resilient floor coverings.

products.name: PROCLASSIC FIRE TOP
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Profiles for floors of equal height Proclassic Fire Top is a line of profiles made of AISI 316 stainless steel, designed to be used as a threshold for fire doors and all doors that require a non-combustible threshold. With a thickness of 2 mm, Proclassic Fire Top is engineered to be installed over existing flooring, whether resilient, textile, or pre-installed wood, including self-laying types, as long as they are not click-lock systems.

products.name: PROCLASSIC R
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Proclassic R is a range of threshold profiles which hide any cutting or laying imperfections in floors sections of different materials, such as the linking of wood and tiles. The convex surface of these profiles helps to offset any 2-3mm differences in height between the two types of floor. Moreover, they are especially easy to lay with either adhesive or screw-fixing. The stainless steel version is recommended for public and private places, and the gleam of the material makes the profiles a great match for the latest in contemporary floors.

products.name: PROFIX THIN C/4
products.category: Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: The Profilpas product collection designed for LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors includes Profix Thin, the dedicated floating floor system for 4-6mm thick floors. In particular, Profix Thin C/4 is a threshold profile in anodised aluminium for floors of different heights, available in a selection of colours with Alcrom® Plus decorations. C/4 comprises a top profile coupled to a PVC base.

products.name: PROFIX THIN S/4
products.category: Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Profiles for LVT floors - by Profilpas Profix Thin is a professional system for laying floating LVT floors, from 4 mm to 8 mm, and which allows for expansion movement. The system comprises base profiles in PVC and top profiles in aluminium, with two different functions: Profiles for floors of equal height Profiles for floors at different heights, creating a smooth transition between two floors that are not level. End profiles to mark the perimeter of LVT floors. The characteristic features of the system are: Easy to lay. Reduced thickness of top profiles. Dimensional stability. Use in floors with thicknesses of 4mm to 6mm. Availability of four anodized finishes and 24 Alcrom Plus coated decorative finishes. The three top profiles should be interlocked onto one of the two PVC bases, which must have been previously screwed or bonded (using a suitable adhesive, like PP/96) to the concrete subfloor.

products.name: PROFIX THIN Z/4
products.category: Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: The Z/4 threshold profile for floors of equal level is part of Profix Thin, the system to lay LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floating floors of thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm. Like the C/4 threshold profile for floors of different heights and S/4 end trim, Profix Thin Z/4 comes with different anodised aluminium and Alcrom® Plus finishes, a wide selection of wood, stone or cement decorations to personalize your profile. C/4 also has a top profile coupled to a PVC base.

products.name: PROFLEX LINE
products.description: Prostep Flex is one of the products in the wide range of bendable profiles by Profilpas, able to adapt perfectly to any kind of curvature. In particular, Prostep Flex is a bendable profile for steps or platforms which have a curved edge. Made of aluminium with various finishes, it can be used, like all solutions in the range, together with the Proflex machine, designed to model profiles and give them a curved shape.

products.name: PROJOINT
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Projoint is a range of separation joints in stainless steel and brass which are perfect for use in areas subject to heavy and frequent loads. Thanks to the simple cross-section, they insert perfectly between floor sections in different materials. Moreover, the stainless steel version can be inserted and polished even after the floor has been cut and laid. Projoint joints are available in different sizes to assure they fit perfectly with the many types of floors to be joined.

products.name: PROJOINT M
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Projoint M is a joint to uncouple and decorate level floors laid with bonded or mortar floors. In aluminium or natural brass, when used between floors of different heights and types, Projoint M has a visible depth of 5 or 10mm, allowing for polishing in both versions.

products.name: PROJOINT R
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Projoint R profiles were designed to split and decorate level granite, wood, tile, marble or other types of floor, and uncouple floors of different materials. The thickness at the top makes them ideal for floors needing polishing, like marble, Venetian and wood.

products.name: PROJOINT T
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Projoint T is the range of profiles specifically for uncoupling, protecting and decorating level floors in different kinds of material, like tiles, marble, granite or wood. This range of profiles for floors of the same height can also be used to hide any imperfections due to the cutting or laying of different materials. The particular cross-section makes Projoint T ideal to offset any slight slopes caused by the coupling of different kinds of floors. The T-shaped cross-section also creates a perfect anchor with sealants and adhesives.

products.name: PROJOINT U
products.category: Profiles for floors of equal height
products.description: Projoint U separation joints, available in stainless steel and brass, are ideal for floors subject to frequent passing heavy loads. The distinctive cross-section of these joints makes them easy to install and extremely practical, they slot seamlessly into the floor to create an even surface.

products.name: PROLEVEL HIGH
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights
products.description: Finding the right joint for floors of different height is no longer a problem with the Prolevel High range of profiles by Profilpas. These products provide a quick and easy solution to unsightly and inconvenient steps between existing floors, up to 16mm in size. The distinctive feature of the range is the high degree of flexibility and different application modes to fit any requirement. The numerous versions come in stainless steel, brass and aluminium.

products.name: PROLEVEL MEDIUM
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights; Profiles for LVT, SPC and resilient floors
products.description: Prolevel Medium is the ideal solution for joining existing floors of low thickness. The profiles - in stainless steel, aluminium or brass - quickly eliminate any unsightly height differences, from 4mm to 6mm, and also come in blister packs (with adhesive or screws); these characteristics assure they are easy to apply and also ideal for DIY use.

products.name: PROLEVEL THIN
products.category: Profiles for floors of different heights
products.description: Prolevel Thin is a range of profiles designed to create joints in PVC floors of different height. These aluminium products, to be fitted after the floor has been laid, are perfect for protecting fragile floor edges from any impact or stress.

products.name: PROLIGHT ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS AND ACCESSORIES
products.description: Electrical components for lighting - by ProfilpasElectrical components for lighting.

products.name: PROLIGHT METAL LINE 88/I6L/A
products.description: Prolight Metal Line 88/I6L/A is a flush recessed skirting board with integrated strip LED lighting, available in height 60mm. Thanks to the distinctive design, light is distributed along the length of the skirting board through a slim slit, left intentionally visible. A dimmer can also be added to adjust the brightness of the light and use the board as a decorative feature or safety night light.

products.name: PROLIGHT METAL LINE 89
products.description: Skirting board - by Profilpas Prolight Metal Line 89 is an aluminium skirting board with the LED lighting system. A diffuser element distributes the light along the entire length of the profile. Prolight Metal Line 89 is available at 60 millimetres in height and offers the option of installing an optional dimmer to regulate the skirting board's light intensity for elegant furnishing functions or friendly night lighting.

products.name: PROLIGHT METAL LINE SKL/2
products.description: Prolight Metal Line S SKL/2 is an aluminium skirting board with indirect LED light. Its special section allows to create an original play of light along the wall and adds value to the whole surface. In addition to the silver anodised this profile is available in different colour-coated aluminium finishes including original cement effects, 2 special metal tonalities and a white characterized by an extremely solid and full colour.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROANGLE Q
products.description: Prolight Proangle Q is a led light profile for external corners with a natural aluminium base, complete with opaline PVD diffuser, available in four colours. In addition to sealing and protecting external corners of tiled wall coverings, to avoid unsightly and delicate 45-degree tile edges, this profile can also be used make public and private locations safer, thanks to the integrated LED strip lighting.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST CLA
products.description: Prolist CLA, a silver anodised aluminium profile with strip LED lighting is also part of the vast Prolight range of LED light profiles. CLA Prolist was designed to cast a pleasant and soft band of light onto wall units, kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes and stands, thanks to the integrated diffuser. Prolist CLA is also available as an adhesive version, in CLA/8A. In connection with these, Profilpas supplies CLA/8P edging, also in anodised aluminium.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST LLA-LLB
products.description: Prolight Prolist is a range of listello tile trims which are perfect for embellishing walls, shelves, wardrobes, mirrors, and is ideal for bathrooms and kitchens. Elements in the Prolight Prolist range have an integrated LED light, either direct or indirect, and are available in aluminium. Each model has its own end trim, for an impeccable end result.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST LQL-2
products.description: Prolight Prolist Q LQL/2 is an aluminium decorative listello with indirect LED light that, thanks to its particular section, creates a delicate and elegant line of light on large-size ceramic slabs, thus embellishing the wall. This profile is available in different colour-coated aluminium finishes including original cement effects, 2 special metal tonalities and a white characterized by an extremely solid and full colour.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST TLA-TLB
products.description: Prolight Prolist TLA and TLB are listello tile trims made of anodized and polished silver finish aluminium, with a strip LED lighting system. Light is distributed along the length of the profile through a downlighter fixed to the side of the profile, making the item especially suited to bathrooms, kitchens, alcoves, etc. End pieces are available to seal the profiles at either end. If you also add a dimmer (optional) the intensity of the lighting can be adjusted as a decorative feature or to provide a night light

products.name: PROLIGHT PROSTEP SGA/11L
products.description: Prolight Prostep SGA/11L is a light stair nosing in silver anodised aluminium, by Profilpas. Prostep SGA/11L is part of the Prolight Prostep range of stair nosings to be laid at the same time as the covering, featuring an LED element which creates an interesting downlight effect. The rounded shape of Prostep SGA/11L sets it apart from other stair nosings in the Prolight Prostep range, and gives the step a touch of class without having to forego safety.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROTECT 126/L/F
products.description: Prolight Protect 126/L/F is a light stair nosing in silver anodised aluminium, to be laid at the same time as the covering. This item has an integrated LED light, providing an excellent solution to the need for light in public spaces like clubs, cinemas, offices, boats and much more. Protect 126/L/F is unlike other stair nosing models on account of the non-slip ridged rubber on the stair tread, combining design with a high standard of safety.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROTECT G/9/F
products.description: Prolight Protect G/9/F is a light stair nosing in silver anodised aluminium, to be laid at the same time as the covering. This article is made of silver anodised aluminium and thanks to the horizontal light emitted from the integrated LED, it provides an excellent solution to the need for light and safety in public spaces like clubs, cinemas, offices, boats and much more.

The huge selection of anchoring accessories completes the product and assures the rods can be quickly removed for regular cleaning or when they need to be replaced.

products.name: PROTECT 111-75

products.name: PROTECT 126
products.description: To protect the edges of existing tiled, marble, wood or carpet steps, Profilpas has perfected a specific range of profiles which includes Protect 126. In silver anodised aluminium, with a replaceable rubber insert, they are manufactured to DIN 51131 governing non-slip steps. For this reason, Protect 126 are advised when building public spaces to safety standards.

products.name: PROTECT 130
products.description: To protect the edges of existing wood, ceramic tile or marble steps, Profilpas has created 130 stair nosings in the Protect range. In terms of fixing, they come pre-drilled or for application with adhesive.

products.name: PROTECT 150-151-152-154
products.description: Protect models 150, 151, 152 e 154 are part of the wide range of profiles that Profilpas makes for stairs. These PVC profiles are ideal to protect the edges of stairs made in different materials: ceramic tile, marble, wood, PVC, linoleum, carpeting and LVT. The different colours available mean they will fit perfectly into any space and can be applied during or after the covering has been laid.

products.name: PROTECT 155
products.description: Protect 155 profiles are PVC profiles built to protect, define and finish the edges of existing tiled, marble, stone, wooden, carpeted, linoleum, PVC or LVT steps. Available in a selection of colours and with a knurled surface, these profiles offer an excellent non-slip solution and meet the requirements of a variety of applications.

products.name: PROTECT 156
products.description: PVC stair nosing profiles Protect 156 play an important role in protecting the edge of tiled, marble, wood, carpeted or other kinds of steps, and are placed during the laying process to make sure they are set into the step covering. Protect 156 profiles come in different formats and dimensions to assure they can be adapted to different sizes and types of coverings..

products.name: PROTECT 70-71
products.description: Protect anodised aluminium profiles 70 and 71 are suitable to protect the corners of existing wood, ceramic tile or marble steps. Given that they comply with DIN 51131 standards regarding non-slip steps, they are an excellent solution when public spaces must comply with safety regulations. They come pre-drilled to be secured with screws or without holes for application with adhesive.

products.name: PROTECT 72
products.description: Protect 72 is an anodised aluminium stair nosing with a replaceable rubber insert: its specific features make it ideal to protect the edges of existing ceramic tile, marble, wood or carpeted stairs. Protect 72 guarantees safety in that it is compliant with the non-slip step requirements of DIN 51131. The profile comes in a pre-drilled version making it the ideal solution for public spaces which must meet safety regulations.

products.name: PROTECT 73-74-58
products.description: Stair nosing profiles - by Profilpas Protect 73, 74, and 58 are profiles to protect the corners of existing wood, ceramic tile, or marble stairs. They are available, depending on the model, with various finishes and in different sizes, to meet every possible aesthetic and functional requirement. Each model comes pre-drilled or for application with adhesive.

products.name: PROTECT 76-110
products.description: Protect 76 and 110 are anodised aluminium profiles to protect the edges of existing ceramic, marble, wood or carpeted steps. These models have a Safety-Step non-slip tape, 19mm wide, replaceable in the event of wear or maintenance. Thanks to this element, Protect 76 and 110 stair nosings are compliant with DIN 51131 standards making them the ideal solution for public spaces which must meet safety regulations.

products.name: PROTECT 78
products.description: Protect 78 is one of the solutions making up the Profilpas range of stair profiles. It is an anodised aluminium profile, used to protect the edges of existing ceramic, marble, wood or carpeted steps. The replaceable rubber insert offers greater safety, by removing any risk of slipping. The profile complies with strict DIN 51131 standards, meaning that Protect 78 is suitable for use in public spaces. It is 48mm wide and 40cm high.

products.name: PROTECT 79-125
products.description: The extensive Profilpas range of stair profiles also includes Protect 79 and 125. These anodised aluminium profiles have a ridged rubber insert, which can be replaced, and are perfect for protecting the edges of existing steps in different materials, like ceramic tile, wood, marble and carpet. They are especially recommended for public spaces which must meet safety regulations thanks to the full compliance with DIN 51131 safety standards regading non-slip steps.

products.name: PROTECT 80
products.description: Protect 80 by Profilpas, in anodised aluminium with a non-slip Safety-Step tape, was designed to provide greater protection at the edges of existing ceramic tile, marble, wood and carpeted steps. The profile complies with DIN 51131 standards regarding non-slip steps, and is suitable for use in public spaces which must meet safety standards.

products.name: PROTECT 87 -370-373
products.description: Protect 87, 370 and 373 profiles are part of the Profilpas range of stair profiles, designed as solutions to assure protection, safety and a pleasant finish. These models comply with DIN 51131 standards regarding non-slip steps and come pre-drilled or for application with adhesive. Protect 87 / in silver anodised aluminium measures 20x20, Protect 370 / is polished brass and also measures 20x20, and Protect 373/ is polished brass measuring 30x30.

products.name: SILANCOLOR BASE COAT
products.category: Preparation of the substrates; Finishing coats for external thermal insulation systems
products.description: Coloured silicon resin-based base paint in water dispersion for filling and evening out surfaces. Silancolor Base Coat is a coloured base product made from silicon resin in water dispersion, micro-granular quartz and selected aggregates which, once applied, evens out the absorbency of the substrate and promotes bonding of successive coats of paint and thick dressing materials from the Silancolor range. Silancolor Base Coat is used to prepare cementitious surfaces before applying a coat of coloured finish, to even out the absorbency of the substrate and to promote a good bond. Silancolor Base Coat is indispensable when applying finishing products with a "scratch-effect" surface, to avoid transparency of the underlying substrate. Silancolor Base Coat may be used to even out the surface, to form a more uniform finish and to cover small imperfections. If applied in white or in a colour similar to that of the final coat, it is particularly useful to help integration of the coloured finishing cycle, when bright colours which only partially cover the surface are used. Silancolor Base Coat works in synergy with coloured finishes, to increase the duration of the protective finish and increase the water repellence of Silancolor finishing systems. Surfaces treated with Silancolor Base Coat have a uniformly rough finish, which makes it easier to apply layered dressing materials, particularly when applied by trowel. This results in a more even distribution of the dressing material over the entire surface. Silancolor Base Coat is available in a wide range of colours, created using the ColorMap® automatic tinting system. Consumption 0.4-0.5 kg/m2 per coat. Consumption is heavily influenced by the roughness of the substrate and by imperfections on the surface, and according to the application technique used. Packaging 20 kg buckets.

Silancolor Cleaner Plus is a water-based anti-mould and anti-alga solution used to clean surfaces damaged by mould and algae before painting with the Silancolor Plus protection system. Silancolor Cleaner Plus forms the basis of the Silancolor Plus protection system for facades, by carrying out a deep-down, cleaning and sanitising action which removes mould and algae from surfaces damaged by such organisms. Silancolor Cleaner Plus, together with the finishing system from the Silancolor Plus range, forms a highly-efficient protective cycle for the surface of walls against algae and fungi which have damaged the surface of walls. Silancolor Cleaner Plus is a cleaning solution which penetrates deep down into the surface, to guarantee thorough cleaning of algae and fungi which have caused damage to the surface of walls. Silancolor Cleaner Plus is odourless and does not contain solvents, which makes it suitable for applications in closed or poorly ventilated areas. Mix Silancolor Cleaner Plus well before use, and dilute it at a ratio of 3:1 with water (5 kg of Silancolor Cleaner Plus in 15 kg of water). Consumption the consumption is heavily influenced by the absorption of the substrate and the amount of mould and algae present on the surface. Typical consumption rate: 0.20-1 kg/m2 of ready-to-use solution. Packaging 5 and 1 kg drums.
